_comment: CANDIDATE alias rows, not loaded by the integration. Each needs a human check before it moves to ha_model_ids.json (design decision 5: matching is curated, never guessed). Built 2026-10-10 from the libraries installed in a Home Assistant 2026.10 container and the live catalog-lite feed (842 devices).

how_to_read.model_id: What Home Assistant reports as model_id or model for the device.
how_to_read.confidence: high: the library name and the SHI name are the same product and nothing else is close. medium: same product, but SHI lists one variant of several or the name differs. low: a guess that needs the device in hand.
how_to_read.shi_id: The catalog record, matched by exact name on 2026-10-10.

candidates.evidence: pySwitchbot 2.9.0 (the HA container's copy): SwitchbotModel value is what HA's switchbot integration writes as the device model. Library calls WoHand 'Bot'. Both Bot versions report WoHand. SHI lists the CR2 one and the rechargeable one; HA cannot tell them apart.

pySwitchbot 2.9.0 (the HA container's copy): SwitchbotModel value is what HA's switchbot integration writes as the device model. Library calls WoCurtain 'Curtain / Curtain 3'. Curtain 1, 2 and 3 all report WoCurtain. SHI lists Curtain 3 rod and track versions only.

pySwitchbot 2.9.0 (the HA container's copy): SwitchbotModel value is what HA's switchbot integration writes as the device model. Library calls WoSensorTH 'Meter / Meter Plus'. Meter and Meter Plus share WoSensorTH; the library tells them apart by an advert byte HA does not store.

Tasmota's discovery message: HA's tasmota integration writes the template/module name (md) as the model, manufacturer 'Tasmota'. Tasmota's built-in 'Sonoff Basic' module covers R1, R2 and R3 boards. SHI lists only the R4, which ships with a different chip. Probably wrong for most installs.

no_shi_record_yet._comment: pySwitchbot model codes with no SHI record. Each is a catalog gap, not an alias.

already_matched_by_model_number._comment: SHI names carry these codes in brackets, so the model-number rule matches them without an alias.

not_covered: Shelly BLU devices arrive through the bthome or shelly integrations with their own model strings; not checked.
Tasmota's md field is whatever template the user flashed, so most Tasmota devices will never alias cleanly.
Zigbee2MQTT, ZHA, TP-Link, Tuya: not started.
